drafts.lead: Bikash Jha, Snow Way Logistics (India) — thinks we want logistics services
drafts.body:
Dear Bikash,

Thanks for coming back. I think there may be a small mix-up, so let me clarify.

We are not looking for logistics services. We run outbound campaigns for 3PLs and warehousing companies, so that Snow Way reaches brands needing fulfilment support and those enquiries come to you directly.

If that is useful, here are a couple of times:

• Monday, August 3 at 5:30 PM IST
• Tuesday, August 4 at 5:30 PM IST

Happy to talk on WhatsApp instead if that is easier, just send me your number.

Kristen

drafts.lead: Teguh Haryanto, Samudera (Indonesia) — asked for an ocean freight quote, thinks we are a forwarder
drafts.body:
Dear Teguh,

Thank you for the detail, though I should be upfront: we are not a freight forwarder, so I cannot quote Ningbo to Tarakan.

What we do is help forwarders like Samudera win more of that work, by putting your name in front of shippers moving that kind of cargo.

If that is of interest:

• Monday, August 3 at 8:00 PM WITA
• Tuesday, August 4 at 8:00 PM WITA

Happy to use WhatsApp instead if that suits you better, or to find an earlier hour if the evening does not work.

Carolyn
